correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the printed susceptible, infected, and predator-mass balances. The delayed infection flux cancels exactly in the Lyapunov--Krasovskii derivative. At the critical relation the remaining derivative is nonpositive; boundedness, Barbalat arguments, scalar comparison, and transport characteristics give convergence of all disease-free components.
risks: The argument relies on the source's established bounded nonnegative solution class and on bounded nonnegative fertility.

value.rationale: The equality surface is the exact nonhyperbolic boundary between the source's proven extinction and invasion regimes. Closing it changes the stated threshold from an open to a closed condition and gives a reusable Lyapunov--Krasovskii balance valid for arbitrary allowed disease delay and predator maturation kernel.
risks: No sharp decay rate at equality is obtained; the value is the exact threshold closure and proof mechanism rather than a quantitative rate theorem.
